name: rateform
description: The thumbs-down form (Ask's answers and the journal's notes): one row as tall as the thumb's box, the field with Send at its end inside one --rule border; "What was wrong?" is its placeholder and its name. It sits in the row that holds the thumbs, after the thumbs down (the thumbs place it); sending it fills the thumb red.

id.description: The field's id, unique on the page (the answer's id with -why): the question labels it.

question.description: The placeholder and the form's accessible name, "What was wrong?".

send.description: "Send" (a quiet button at the line's end, the form's submit).

value.description: Words already typed (the catalogue's long and non-Latin fixtures); the product opens it empty.

states.default: yes: open, the empty field with its placeholder, Send
states.hover: n/a: the buttons carry their own hover
states.focus-visible: yes: the box's own border, 2px in --block, drawn inward (--w-focus); Send its own
states.active: n/a: the buttons carry their own press
states.disabled: n/a: Send is always available; an empty reason is still a thumbs down
states.selected: n/a: nothing in it is chosen
states.loading: n/a: the thumb fills at once; nothing waits
states.error: n/a: nothing here can be refused

events.send: the form submitted (Send, or Enter): bubbling, detail { why } (the words, trimmed). Its parent fills the thumb and closes it.
events.cancel: Escape: bubbling. Its parent closes it and returns focus to the thumb.

behaviour.script: rateform.js, inside its root only: the submit is the form's own (it never navigates) and dispatches send; Escape dispatches cancel. Showing, hiding, placing and clearing it are its parent's.

hooks.input: The field: its parent focuses it on opening and clears it on closing.

a11y.keyboard: Tab to the field and Send; Enter sends, Escape cancels (the thumb again closes it too)
a11y.labels: the question is the field's accessible name and its placeholder

responsive.all: as wide as its parent gives it (the thumbs: up to 320px, at least 180px); 44px tall at every width

changelog.change: New (v4 C2): from explore ask-readable a-mirror-bubble, the compact thumbs-down form.
v4 round 10: the field's focus is its own border at 2px in --block, drawn inward, not a ring outside it.
v4 round 10: form line, a note's thumbs-down form: one row as tall as the thumb's box, after the thumbs down, so it never falls behind the next entry in a list.

v4 round 10: one line everywhere (the user): Ask's answers take the note's line form; the card (the hand's question, two-line field, Cancel, the floating shadow and --aj-c-rateform-origin) is retired, and the placeholder and cancel content with it. Enter sends.

places.send: Send at the line's end: no box, the row's height, --s4 each side, inside the form's border
